trialComponents.name: Apartment block
trialComponents.trigger: Storeys / building program
trialComponents.note: A repeated floor template; no invented facade specification.

trialComponents.name: Mixed-use podium
trialComponents.trigger: Retail + podium + explicit roof flags
trialComponents.note: Lab fixture includes balconies and a green roof; these are attachments, not inferred design.

trialComponents.name: Townhouse row
trialComponents.size: 4 × 4.4 m illustrative bays · 9 m to the eaves, 10.7 m to the gable
trialComponents.trigger: Confirmed townhouse program
trialComponents.note: Repeat homes along the street at a fixed height. Rear rows need separate blocks; the strip does not infer site layout.

trialComponents.name: Deciduous tree
trialComponents.trigger: Landscape input / mapped tree / scene dressing
trialComponents.note: A small family of rounded, upright and irregular silhouettes; species and exact location are not asserted.

trialComponents.name: Pocket park
trialComponents.trigger: Park program / mapped park
trialComponents.note: Play equipment is a synthetic lab attachment; park area alone does not establish it.

trialComponents.name: Bus shelter
trialComponents.trigger: Mapped shelter / explicit proposal
trialComponents.note: A bus stop without shelter evidence gets a stop marker, not this pavilion.

trialComponents.name: Subway entrance
trialComponents.trigger: Known entrance / explicitly proposed entrance
trialComponents.note: Generic stair and elevator symbols; proximity to transit is not an entrance location.

trialComponents.name: Small car
trialComponents.trigger: Decorative scale reference
trialComponents.note: Side elevation shows vehicle length, not vehicle width. No traffic count is implied.

trialComponents.name: Street furniture
trialComponents.trigger: Documented public realm / illustrative dressing
trialComponents.note: Lamp, bench, bin, cycle racks and person share one scale.

trialComponents.name: Creek + footbridge
trialComponents.trigger: Mapped water and independently known bridge
trialComponents.note: Water proximity alone does not establish a bridge, access, or shoreline frontage.

trialComponents.name: Office block
trialComponents.trigger: Confirmed office program
trialComponents.note: Repeated office floors and continuous glazing scale with height; fins are illustrative template details.

trialComponents.name: Industrial block
trialComponents.trigger: Industrial or warehouse program
trialComponents.note: Generic loading doors and metal-panel marks; operational layout is illustrative.

trialComponents.name: Civic block
trialComponents.size: 12 m frontage · 6.7 m illustrative roof peak
trialComponents.trigger: Confirmed civic or community program
trialComponents.note: Public portico and arched windows distinguish this generic template; no named institution or architectural proposal is implied.

trialComponents.name: Shopfront attachment
trialComponents.trigger: Retail component
trialComponents.note: Reusable glazing, entrance and blank sign band. No tenant or shop category is assumed.

trialComponents.name: Green roof attachment
trialComponents.trigger: Explicit green-roof input
trialComponents.note: Drops onto a roof anchor; area and roof availability must come from the model.

trialComponents.name: Solar attachment
trialComponents.trigger: Explicit solar PV input
trialComponents.note: A visual array symbol, not a panel-count, energy-yield or roof-layout calculation.

trialComponents.name: City bus
trialComponents.trigger: Mode-confirmed bus context or illustrative vehicle
trialComponents.note: Generic route display and livery; not a live vehicle, service frequency or capacity claim.

trialComponents.name: Delivery van
trialComponents.trigger: Illustrative servicing activity
trialComponents.note: Generic scale reference; does not establish delivery access or loading approval.

trialComponents.name: Pedestrian figures
trialComponents.size: Adults around 1.7 m · three clean silhouettes
trialComponents.trigger: Illustrative street life
trialComponents.note: Walking, standing and wheelchair figures. No demographic or pedestrian-volume inference.

trialComponents.name: Cyclist
trialComponents.trigger: Illustrative street life or cycling context
trialComponents.note: Filled rider with clean bicycle geometry. No traffic volume or cycle-lane availability is implied.

trialComponents.name: Reserved school site
trialComponents.trigger: School-board reservation from the map or a planning condition
trialComponents.note: A reserved site is land, not a school: no building is drawn until one is confirmed.

trialComponents.name: Existing building
trialComponents.trigger: Retained or neighbouring building from the map (footprint and height when known)
trialComponents.note: Neutral, hatched context massing; no facade is invented for a building nobody has surveyed.

trialComponents.name: Land plot
trialComponents.trigger: Lot area and frontage (program inputs, mapped parcel)
trialComponents.note: Corner stakes and the frontage dimension are schematic; parcel lines are not survey-grade.

trialComponents.name: Future-phase block
trialComponents.trigger: Later phase in a master plan (phase offset)
trialComponents.note: A dashed envelope only: a placeholder for timing, not a design.

trialComponents.name: Balcony
trialComponents.size: 4.2 m bay · slab, guard and door
trialComponents.trigger: Balcony count or type in the program
trialComponents.note: Slab, glass guard and the shadow it throws; projection depth is illustrative.

trialComponents.name: Entrance
trialComponents.trigger: Every building has one; position is illustrative
trialComponents.note: Recessed double doors, canopy, address plaque and a level threshold. No accessibility audit is implied.

trialComponents.name: Roof terrace
trialComponents.size: 10 m deck on a roof anchor
trialComponents.trigger: Explicit rooftop amenity input
trialComponents.note: Decking, planters, glass guard, shade and pergola; area and access must come from the model.

trialComponents.name: Tree cluster
trialComponents.trigger: Mapped tree canopy or landscape input
trialComponents.note: Three overlapping canopies; species, count and location are not asserted.

trialComponents.name: Plaza / POPS
trialComponents.trigger: Plaza or POPS area in the program, or a mapped POPS
trialComponents.note: Paving grid, seating wall, planters and public art; not a landscape plan.

trialComponents.name: Playground
trialComponents.trigger: Explicit playground or park program
trialComponents.note: Safety surface, fence and equipment; park area alone does not establish a playground.

trialComponents.name: Rain garden
trialComponents.trigger: Stormwater measures in the program or explicit landscape
trialComponents.note: A basin below grade with a curb inlet; sizing belongs to the servicing engineer.

trialComponents.name: Lake edge
trialComponents.trigger: Water within the chosen distance of the site (map proximity)
trialComponents.note: Shoreline as context; water nearby does not establish public access or a boardwalk.

trialComponents.name: Ravine / woodland
trialComponents.trigger: TRCA regulated area, ravine or natural-heritage layers
trialComponents.note: A wooded valley with a creek; the regulated limit and setbacks come from TRCA, not this picture.

trialComponents.name: Crossing
trialComponents.trigger: Mapped signalised or marked crossing at the frontage
trialComponents.note: Zebra bars, curb ramps, tactile plates and a pedestrian signal; signal timing is not implied.

trialComponents.name: Cycle lane
trialComponents.trigger: Mapped cycle infrastructure on the frontage street
trialComponents.note: Painted lane with flex posts; the protection type comes from the cycling network data.

trialComponents.name: Bus-stop pole
trialComponents.trigger: Mapped bus stop without a shelter
trialComponents.note: Stop flag and timetable case; routes and frequency are not implied.

trialComponents.name: Rail platform
trialComponents.trigger: GO or rail station within the mapped station area
trialComponents.note: Platform, canopy, edge strip and stair; the station layout is illustrative.

trialComponents.name: Train
trialComponents.trigger: Rail corridor or station-area context
trialComponents.note: A generic bilevel coach; no service level or operator livery.

trialComponents.name: Truck
trialComponents.trigger: Loading or servicing activity (loading space input)
trialComponents.note: A box truck at scale; does not establish loading access or turning space.

trialComponents.name: Policy-limit overlay
trialComponents.size: Height limit, angular plane and setback
trialComponents.trigger: Mapped height limit, angular plane and setback
trialComponents.note: Red dashed limits over a ghosted envelope; the by-law text and its exceptions govern.
